annotations.title: Get matched skills, MCPs, repos and prompts

description: Returns up to `limit` catalog items matched to the agent's goals, plus at most one extra item per declared capability gap. Each item includes match reasons, vetting status and basis, and cautions. Requires the agent's api_key.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.
